I, like many of us, am concerned as to the financial future of this site. We've been running so far on donations, a handful of ad buys (likely not even a months worth of server time has been bought by them, unfortunately. After the initial ad buys from "Ohh, new shiny feature," I've seen very few new ads), the first merch run, and now the second merch run, as well as tons of support from our hard working goats in chief.

I don't think any of this is enough. We got 2k from our first merch sale, prior to which we were basically running on fumes. Unfortunately, I am unable to find hard numbers for costs (which is weird, since I could swear we had some floating around somewhere), but we DO know that donations have not been enough to cover the site in the past,, and Atko has since shown significant agitation about site finances, so its safe to assume that the first merch drive money is LONG gone. This lines up with my personal suspicions as to voat's cost quite well, but, since those suspicions are far from fact, I'll refrain from including them here. The current merch drive started yesterday has already accumulated, at a guess, 300+ sales, including stickers. If we assume 200 shirts and hoodies have been sold, at 10 dollars apiece net, we've made 2 thousand (yes, I know, operating on a LOT of assumptions here). This is a nice cash injection, but, since our hosting costs have doubtless increased since the last run, it's not going to last long.

Merchandise cannot sustain us forever. Not only will this merch drive likely be the most profitable per unit we will ever have (as atko mentioned, the manufacturer is opting to sell the shirts at cost to maximize our profit. While great for us, this is unlikely to be a frequent occurrence), but basic economics tells us that, unless we get more users at a consistent rate, our relatively small market will get saturated pretty quickly, and, of course, if we get more users, it ends up costing more to keep the site running. Merch isn't a solution on its own, donations are not a solution on their own, ads have been paying a pittance, and we don't know what is in the works for fixing this problem. This is an issue. While I have great respect for the admins, and the work they put in to making this site a true bastion of free speech, the bulk of this hosting money has come from us, the community. They are NOT giving us any hard data on how that money is being used. While I personally trust Atko and Putt, it does not change this fact.

We need a permanent solution, as Atko has mentioned in the past, but we are not equipped to create such a solution as a community. Why? Because any guesses we DO make as to running costs and funds raised are just that, guesses. WE provided this money, we should know EXACTLY how much of it we have, how much it takes to stay in the black each month, and details on what plans are being made to ensure future stability. Without this information, the community is unable to help identify possible solutions effectively. It's been 3 months since our last traffic report, and those reports have a serious flaw, they lack any fine financial data.
